app.title: FLAIL! Tools
app.description: Rolls dungeons, caves, wizard towers and hexcrawl locations for FLAIL!, draws them a map, and gives you a link that rebuilds exactly what you saw.

licence.independentHtml: FLAIL! Tools is an independent production by the flail-tools contributors and is not affiliated with Games Omnivorous. It is published under the Games Omnivorous Third-Party Licence.
licence.copyrightHtml: FLAIL is copyright of Games Omnivorous.
licence.contentHtml: The Games Omnivorous Third-Party Licence permits reusing FLAIL!'s rules, mechanics, terminology and random tables, table entries included, and still forbids reproducing its artwork or its written prose. The book's tables could therefore be used here; they are not. This tool implements the procedures from the book and fills them with tables written from scratch, so nothing here is transcribed or paraphrased from FLAIL!. If you want the game itself, buy it — this is a tool for people who already own it.

messages.mapAlt: A hand-drawn map of the site
messages.noContentBody: The generator, the maps and the seeds are all working, but the tables came back with no rows in them, so every field is blank. This normally means the data files did not load rather than that anything was rolled badly.
